title: 第4章 进山
content_zh:
时光荏茬，如白驹过隙，转瞬两月过去。

半山腰，百丈方圆的平坦场地，数百青衣弟子或单人或双双对战，练习着各种武技，看上去好不热闹。

本就炎热的夏季清晨，因这一群生龙活虎的少年男女，多了磅礴生机。

场地边缘的青石小道上，黎晨挑着两桶水箭步来到近前。

那几名吆喝他的外门弟子也不客气的围上前来，其中一名膀大腰圆，看外貌虽然比黎晨大了三两岁，但明显稚气未脱年龄相若的少年，径直捧起桶中井水，浇在头上，丝毫没有畏惧这泛着寒意的井水。

其余几人在少年喝了几口之后，这才一拥而上，不一会功夫，黎晨费了半个多时辰才挑到这的井水，泼洒了个干净。

黎晨只是在旁腼腆的看着，不时傻愣愣的笑呵呵几声，暗地里打量着远处，正在练习武技的弟子。

围近之人见状，擦了擦额头的汗水，想要围上来，那壮硕少年冷冷的环视一周，登时令他们缩了缩脖子。

眼见无人上前，壮硕少年满意的点点头，一把抓起百多斤重的水桶，径直向不远处的一圈女弟子走去。

黎晨从散乱的发隙中看去，发现那四五名不过二八年华的女子中，正有李家三小姐李月蓉。

“楚师妹，天怪热的，这寒池水清热解毒，最好不过！”

壮硕少年走到近前，轻轻放下木桶，瓮声瓮气道。

“哟！庞文山，又来献殷勤了，你也要有点诚意啊，拿别人打来的水，来讨好我们紫芸师姐？”

一名身材不错，脸上有少许雀斑的女弟子，啧啧有声的上下打量着少年，手臂挽着另一名容貌清丽，隐隐在李月蓉之上的少女。

楚紫芸黛眉微蹙，轻晃了晃雀斑女。

“赵师妹说的是，下次我自己去打！对了，明天何师兄说要进山，我们正好跟着一起去。”

“咯咯，别浪费了人家一片好心！”

赵珊珊娇笑出声，抽出一条丝巾，轻沾了些水，自顾自的擦了起来。

几女也不客气，各自取出丝巾擦拭着青春洋溢的俏丽，唯独李月容，冷冷的瞪了一眼黎晨。

眼见她们收拾完毕，庞文山这才嘿然一笑，扭头挥了挥手，“那个谁，把水桶带走！”

黎晨一路小跑到近前，抓起水桶，向李月蓉俯身行礼：“三小姐好！”

赵珊珊眼睛一亮，不怀好意的看向李月蓉，赵家同样是落凰城家族之一，与李家乃是对头。

几女痴痴笑了几声，对着离去的黎晨背影指指点点，神情间满是不屑与厌恶，只有楚紫芸眉头微皱，没有多说什么。

如此毫不遮掩的话语，自然让周围之人听的真切，不远处的黎晨，却是丝毫未觉一般，几步便离开了场地。

其实黎晨生的不丑，甚至还有一点秀气，但其面上遮盖了左眼与太阳穴的凸起暗红色胎记，却是让他显得丑陋无比。

当然，对于这些天之娇女而言，黎晨生的俊丑与否，与她们根本没有丝毫关系。

落云峰南部数百里外，古苍山外围一处隐秘的山坳中，十数名玄云宗弟子汇聚在一处，分成三波讨论着什么。

为首者三名身穿蓝衣的内门弟子中，正有何空明，中间八人身穿青衣，有男有女，便有黎晨认识的李月蓉、楚紫芸、赵珊珊、庞文山等人。

“陈师兄，我叫柳乘风，进了古苍山，多多照顾啊！”

最后三名身穿灰衣弟子，其中一名身材中等，双目狭长的少年，一脸讨好的对着陈松泰，斜背一柄连鞘长剑。

“我修为与你相当，此番能够进山，还是要靠何师兄、卢师兄几位照拂，哪里谈得上照顾柳师弟？”

陈松泰紧了紧后背的长剑，小心的看了前面众人一眼，压低了声音，随意的摆摆手。

“能跟在何师兄身边做事，那真是福分，听闻何师兄炼制一阶中品丹药的成功率已经达到了三成，前途不可限量啊！”

陈松泰一扬下巴，“内门弟子中，论炼丹之术，何师兄若说第二，没人敢排第一！”

那一脸得意的神情，仿似他才是内门弟子炼丹第一之人。

黎晨一直没有出言，有些呆愣的跟随众人一路到此，但隐藏在发梢下的双目，却是仔细的打量着周围。

早就听说古苍山乃是妖兽汇聚之所，其内凶险极多，机缘更是不少，各种宝物层出不穷，常年来无数武者进出其中寻找宝物机缘。

这一次跟随到此，也不过是搭把帮手，为众弟子收拾杂物罢了。

当然，身为内门弟子的何空明三人，只不过是一路带着这帮外门弟子到此，他们自身另有要事。

“好了，你们开始搜索这一带的灵药吧，这里的妖兽都是一阶中期左右，以你们的实力，加上庞师弟照拂，不会有危险！”

在众人休息了盏茶工夫后，何空明抚掌起身，安排了下事宜，便于另外两名内门弟子互视一眼，联袂闪身向山林中掠去。

见状，庞文山站起，向陈松泰三人招了招手。

“此番进山，虽然主要是为何师兄搜集辅助药材，但你们大多从未进过古苍山，待会看到妖兽出现不要惊慌，三人一组互相辅助，若遇妖兽以哨声为准，先保护好自己，知道了吗？”

庞文山胖大的身躯，与略显年长的脸庞，显得颇有威慑力，从衣襟中掏出了一个指许长青色哨子。

此为青风笛，可声传数里，多为玄云宗弟子入山时联络之用。

据黎晨所知，庞文山一身修为达到了六层巅峰，只差一步便可踏入七层，进入内门弟子之列。

一群十四五岁的少年男女，虽然一脸兴奋，恨不得立刻与妖兽厮杀一番，但也知晓其中凶险，纷纷点头。

这些人，除了没有后台，修为不过五层的陈松泰三人，在他们八人中，另有几人也是五层修为。

不过，年龄都不大，只有十五岁，资质也是不弱。

至于楚紫芸，虽然不过十四岁，已是六层巅峰，资质相当惊人。

在庞文山的安排下，三两成群互有照应的开始进入山坳树林中，搜寻隐藏在其中的各种低阶药材。

虽然古苍山宝物极多，但来的武者也不少，此番何空明带他们到的地方，便是一处人迹罕至的山谷。

除了防备妖兽之外，最危险的当属经常出入古苍山的冒险者。

修为弱，兼之是两名内门弟子随从的陈松泰三人，自是成了一组。

仗着为何空明打理药材年许，陈松泰毫不客气的接过小组的指挥权，一路喋喋不休的讲述着各种药理，听得柳乘风云里雾里。

正走之间，黎晨轻嗅了下空气，眼中闪过一抹亮色，身形一转的向旁边走去。

衣袂飘起，陈松泰脚下轻点，掠过黎晨，径直奔出了数丈远，一脸喜意的俯下身，掏出随身携带的玉铲，将一株指许长短，通体青翠，不过三个嫩叶的灵药挖出。

“续气草，一阶中品灵药，运气不错！”

陈松泰喜滋滋的从身后的背囊内拿出一个玉匣，小心的放入其中，看也没看黎晨一眼，昂首挺胸的前行。

“陈师兄厉害，是不是有什么诀窍啊？教教小弟！”

陈松泰嘿然一笑，故作神秘，摇头晃脑的四下里搜寻。

两人前行中，丝毫没有注意到，原本跟随在两人身后的黎晨，瞧瞧落后了几个身形，一个闪身的没入浓密的树林中消失不见。

待得两人发现黎晨失踪，陈松泰面色微变，从怀中掏出青风笛，放在唇边，神色几经变换最终放下。

不知与柳乘风说了些什么，最终两人当做什么都没有发生的继续前行。
content_en:
Time flies by, like a white horse passing by, and two months pass in the blink of an eye.

Halfway up the mountain, on a flat field with a radius of a hundred feet, hundreds of Tsing Yi disciples were fighting alone or in pairs, practicing various martial arts. It looked very lively.

The already hot summer morning was filled with vitality because of this group of lively young men and women.

On the bluestone path at the edge of the field, Li Chen walked forward carrying two buckets of water.

The few outer disciples who yelled at him gathered around him unceremoniously. One of them, a tall and round-waisted boy who looked almost three or two years older than Li Chen but was obviously still childish, picked up the well water in the bucket and poured it on his head. He was not afraid of the chilly well water.

After the young man drank a few sips, the other people swarmed over him. After a while, it took Li Chen more than half an hour to pick up the well water and splash it all.

Li Chen just looked on shyly, laughing stupidly from time to time, secretly sizing up the disciples who were practicing martial arts in the distance.

When the people around him saw this, they wiped the sweat from their foreheads and wanted to surround him. The strong young man looked around coldly, which immediately made them shrink back.

Seeing that no one came forward, the sturdy young man nodded with satisfaction, grabbed a bucket weighing more than 100 kilograms, and walked straight to a circle of female disciples not far away.

Li Chen looked through the gaps in his scattered hair and found that among the four or five women who were no more than 28 years old, there was Li Yuerong, the third daughter of the Li family.

"Junior sister Chu, it's extremely hot. This cold pond water can clear away heat and detoxify, it's the best!"

The sturdy young man walked closer and gently put down the barrel, making a loud sound.

"Hey! Pang Wenshan, you're here to show your courtesy again. You have to be a little sincere. Are you using water brought by others to please our senior sister Ziyun?"

A female disciple with a good figure and a few freckles on her face looked up and down at the young man, holding her arm with another girl with a beautiful appearance, who was faintly above Li Yuerong.

Chu Ziyun frowned slightly and shook the freckled girl.

"What Junior Sister Zhao said is that next time I will fight by myself! By the way, Senior Brother He said he wants to go into the mountains tomorrow, so we just go with him."

"Gee, don't let someone's good intentions go to waste!"

Zhao Shanshan laughed out loud, took out a silk scarf, lightly dipped it in some water, and wiped it off.

The girls were not polite and each took out their silk scarves to wipe their youthful beauty. Only Li Yuerong glared at Li Chen coldly.

Seeing that they had finished cleaning up, Pang Wenshan smiled, turned around and waved, "Who, take the bucket away!"

Li Chen trotted forward, grabbed the bucket, bowed to Li Yuerong and saluted: "Hello, Miss Third!"

Zhao Shanshan's eyes lit up and she looked at Li Yuerong with ill intentions. The Zhao family was also one of the Luohuang City families and was the enemy of the Li family.

The girls laughed foolishly and pointed at Li Chen's back as he left, with expressions full of disdain and disgust. Only Chu Ziyun frowned slightly and said nothing more.

Such unabashed words were naturally heard by the people around him. Li Chen, who was not far away, did not notice it at all and left the venue in a few steps.

In fact, Li Chensheng was not ugly, and was even a little delicate, but the raised dark red birthmark on his face that covered his left eye and temple made him look extremely ugly.

Of course, for these beauties, whether Li Chensheng is handsome or ugly has nothing to do with them.

Hundreds of miles south of Luoyun Peak, in a hidden mountain col on the outskirts of Gucang Mountain, a dozen Xuanyun Sect disciples gathered together and divided into three waves to discuss something.

Among the three inner disciples in blue clothes at the head was He Kongming. Among the eight people in the middle were men and women in green clothes, including Li Yuerong, Chu Ziyun, Zhao Shanshan, Pang Wenshan and others whom Li Chen knew.

"Senior Brother Chen, my name is Liu Chengfeng. I have entered Gucang Mountain. Please take good care of me!"

Among the last three disciples in gray clothes, one of them was a young man with a medium build and narrow eyes. He looked at Chen Songtai with a flattering look on his face and slung a sheathed long sword across his back.

"My cultivation level is comparable to yours. If I can enter the mountain this time, I still have to rely on Senior Brother He and Senior Brother Lu to take care of me. How can I take care of Junior Brother Liu?"

Chen Songtai tightened the long sword on his back, carefully glanced at the people in front, lowered his voice, and waved his hands casually.

"It's such a blessing to be able to work with Senior Brother He. I heard that Senior Brother He's success rate in refining first-level middle-grade elixirs has reached 30%. The future is limitless!"

Chen Songtai raised his chin, "Among the inner disciples, when it comes to the art of alchemy, if Senior Brother He is ranked second, no one dares to be ranked first!"

The proud look on his face made it look like he was the number one inner disciple in alchemy.

Li Chen remained silent and followed everyone here in a daze, but his eyes hidden under his hair were looking at the surroundings carefully.

I have long heard that Gucang Mountain is a place where monsters and beasts gather. There are many dangers in it, and there are many opportunities. All kinds of treasures emerge in endlessly. Over the years, countless warriors have gone in and out to find treasures and opportunities.

This time I followed him here, just to help out and clean up the miscellaneous things for the disciples.

Of course, the three inner disciples, He Kongming and others, just brought this group of outer disciples all the way here, and they had other important matters of their own.

"Okay, you guys start searching for the elixir in this area. The monsters here are all around the mid-first level. With your strength and the care of Junior Brother Pang, there will be no danger!"

After everyone had a rest for a cup of tea, He Kongming stood up with his palms in his hands and arranged things so that the other two inner disciples could look at each other and sneak into the forest together.

Seeing this, Pang Wenshan stood up and waved to Chen Songtai and the others.

"This trip to the mountain is mainly for senior brother to collect auxiliary medicinal materials, but most of you have never been to Gucang Mountain. Don't panic when you see monsters appearing later. You should work in groups of three to help each other. If you encounter monsters, listen to the whistle and protect yourself first. Do you understand?"

Pang Wenshan's fat body and slightly older face looked quite intimidating. He took out an evergreen whistle from his clothes.

This is a green bagpipe, which can carry the sound for several miles. It is mostly used by Xuanyun Sect disciples to communicate when they go to the mountains.

As far as Li Chen knew, Pang Wenshan's cultivation had reached the peak of the sixth level, and he was only one step away from stepping into the seventh level and becoming an inner disciple.

A group of young men and women aged fourteen or fifteen years old, although they looked excited and wanted to fight the monster immediately, they also knew that it was dangerous and nodded one after another.

Among these people, apart from the three Chen Songtai who had no backing and were only at the fifth level, among the eight of them, there were several others who were also at the fifth level.

However, he is not old, only fifteen years old, and his qualifications are not weak.

As for Chu Ziyun, although she is only fourteen years old, she is already at the peak of the sixth level, and her qualifications are quite astonishing.

Under Pang Wenshan's arrangement, groups of two or three, taking care of each other, began to enter the woods of the mountain col, searching for various low-level medicinal materials hidden in them.

Although there are many treasures in Gu Cang Mountain, there are also many warriors coming. The place He Kongming took them to this time was a valley that was rarely visited by people.

In addition to guarding against monsters, the most dangerous ones are the adventurers who often visit Gucang Mountain.

The three of Chen Songtai, who were weak in cultivation and were followers of two inner disciples, naturally formed a group.

Relying on why He Kongming had been managing medicinal materials for many years, Chen Songtai took over the command of the group unceremoniously and kept talking about various pharmacological theories, which made Liu Chengfeng confused.

While walking, Li Chen sniffed the air, a flash of light flashed in his eyes, and he turned and walked to the side.

With his clothes fluttering, Chen Songtai tapped his feet, passed by Li Chen, and ran straight away a few feet away. He leaned down with a joyful expression, took out the jade shovel he carried with him, and dug out an elixir that was about a few inches long and green, with no more than three young leaves.

"Qi-Sustaining Grass, a first-order middle-grade elixir, good luck!"

Chen Songtai happily took out a jade box from the backpack behind him and carefully put it into it. Without even looking at Li Chen, he walked forward with his head held high.

"Senior Brother Chen is awesome. Do you have any tips? Teach me some tips!"

Chen Songtai smiled, pretending to be mysterious, shaking his head and looking around.

As the two of them moved forward, they did not notice at all that Li Chen, who was originally following them, fell a few figures behind them and disappeared into the dense woods.

When the two of them discovered that Li Chen was missing, Chen Songtai's expression changed slightly. He took out the green bagpipe from his arms and put it to his lips. His expression changed several times and he finally put it down.

I don’t know what they said to Liu Chengfeng, but in the end the two of them moved on as if nothing happened.
